answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 24868 Country: India Title: Masah on Cloth Socks! Question: Masah on Cloth Socks! Answer ID: 24868 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1580/1246/B=1431) Masah on khuffain (wiping on leather socks for getting taharah) finds mention in Hadith. Socks made of cloth are not termed as khuffain, rather the leather socks are known by this name. Thus, one should do masah on leather socks only. It is not lawful to do masah on cotton socks. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
